description: This Java class 'FlexibleLocation' provides a flexible URL-like location resolver that supports multiple location types such as http, https, ftp, jar, file, classpath, ofbizhome, component, and additional custom resolvers loaded from 'locationresolvers.properties'. It offers methods to parse location strings, resolve them into URLs, and manage different location resolvers, facilitating resource access within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FlexibleLocation
classes.description: A utility class that resolves location strings into URL objects supporting various protocols and custom resolvers.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string into a URL object, auto-detecting the location type and using the appropriate resolver.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string into a URL object using a specified ClassLoader, supporting custom resolvers.

methods.name: getLocationType
methods.description: Extracts the location type (protocol) from the location string, defaults to 'classpath' if none found.

methods.name: stripLocationType
methods.description: Removes the location type prefix and any leading slashes from a location string.
